info.title: Freesoloing a Monstrous 5.10 in Shasta | The Sufferfest with Alex Honnold and Cedar Wright, Ep. 3
info.description:
http://www.epictv.com

Just when you thought The Sufferfest couldn't get any more hardcore, we find out that not only will Cedar Wright, Alex Honnold (and guest Sean Leary) be cycling between all their 14ers, they will be FREESOLOing the routes' technical lines as well. These guys are serious ...ly mental.

After a bum-blistering 460 mile ride from Shasta, Honnold and Cedar are questioning the wisdom of trying to climb all of California's 14ers by bike.  They are exhausted and approaching the climbs unpsyched. 

But then, their good friend Sean Leary meets them at the trailhead, bringing a muc…[truncated]
